test_added: src/web_host/mod.zig: 'a store failure answers the failure header and writes no host line of its own, on the forget arm' and '... on the save arm' drive a real DELETE/POST /current-file through pointerRequestReply with a FailingAllocator-backed session, asserting HTTP 500 + core's generic body + 'X-Sudoku-Failure: OutOfMemory' + no refusal header + an empty host log sink; together with src/wasm/host_api.test.mjs and src/wasm/flows/step_runner.test.mjs (header reaches the answer core logs), src/native/shell/shell.zig 'startup: a forget the adapter could not complete ...' (terminal shows forget_mod.FAILED_MSG, save still on disk) and the new startup_restore_failed_delete_settings_unwritable parity scenario.
concerns: src/web_host/mod.zig:1155 asserts `expectEqual(PointerOutcome{ .failed = "OutOfMemory" }, pointerError(config_store.Error.OutOfMemory))`, and expectEqual on that union compares the []const u8 payload by pointer rather than content: it is green in `zig build verify` only because the literal happens to coalesce with the error-name string, and it goes red ('expected slice ptr u8@16bcbf0, found u8@10045cb') under the documented single-test run even though the production code is correct, so the assertion proves an address coincidence instead of the error name (compare the tag, then expectEqualStrings).

src/test/parity/native.zig:690-692 returns `error.SkipZigTest` from inside the per-scenario loop, so when the read-only settings file cannot be staged (any root run, e.g. a root CI container) the whole parity test reports SKIP and the 36 scenarios after `startup_restore_failed_delete_settings_unwritable` are never compared while the gate stays green — a root run of the suite printed 'SKIP / 3 passed; 1 skipped; 0 failed' with no transcripts written; use `continue` (recording the gap for that one scenario) instead of `return`.

FAIL (TestExpectedEqual)'; (2) re-adding the same line in `pointerError` -> the save arm 'FAIL (TestExpectedEqual)'; (3) dropping the header from `answerFailure` (`writeFull` instead of `writeFullWithHeader`) -> both request tests 'FAIL (TestUnexpectedResult)' plus the mapping test red; (4) making `pointerErrorText` return the bare status -> `node src/wasm/host_api.test.mjs` aborts with 'actual { ok: false, error: "current-file forget failed: 500" } expected ...
